Lorde File Quest

A two-level game that tests the native Open and Save dialogs — the agent must finish it without touching an OS window.

1 Attach the key — native Open dialog

Click Choose file. A native file picker opens; the agent answers it with browser_file_dialog_accept and the file becomes the level-1 key.

…or drop a file here
Any file works — a .txt, .png, .json. The picker reports the name, size and type back into the log.

2 Save your inventory — native Save dialog

Click Save inventory. The page starts a download; the agent routes it with browser_downloads_set_path, so no Save dialog appears.

Save these to: C:\Users\london\lorde-quest\
On macOS or Linux the same folder is ~/lorde-quest/. The agent sets this directory with browser_downloads_set_path before clicking save.

3 Event log

Everything the page observes, in order — this is the evidence the agent can quote back.
